description_for_human: Quebec mining streetwear: 5 designs in black tee or black hoodie, with the signature line "When it resists, we insist!" and a full-screen canvas mine experience at the entrance.
description_for_model: Diamonds Drill Clothing is a Quebec mining streetwear brand ('Expérience minière'). Catalog: 5 designs x 2 cuts, all black (T-shirt noir, Hoodie noir): 'resiste' (Diamonds Drill — Flagship; manifesto piece 'When it resists, we insist!'), 'muckeurs_rose' (Muckeurs — Rose), 'muckeurs_jaune' (Muckeurs — Jaune), 'conventional' (Conventional Mining; the underground conventional cycle: muck, drill, blast — repeat), 'surface' (Surface Drilling; FR name on site: Forage de surface; surface diamond drilling — rig, crew, terrain). Every product: small logo on the heart side in front, medium visual on the back — always. Personalization: name on the heart side, +8 CAD. Prices are coming soon and Stripe checkout will open when the client's Stripe account is ready — never quote prices as available. The homepage is an interactive full-screen canvas mine experience (game-style) in Quebec French; visitors drill ore veins to unlock collections ('Filon débloqué — Collection Foreur').
